title: $L^p$ Bounds for the Triangular Hilbert Transform
exact_target: Determine the range of exponents for which the triangular Hilbert transform, the trilinear singular integral with kernel $(x+y+z)^{-1}$, is bounded on the corresponding $L^p$ spaces.
